mechanism.claim: At a fixed eight-hour UTC boundary in an already elevated BVOL-and-DVOL regime, six hours of large but directionally inefficient BTC close-path movement stores two-sided risk; a final two-hour close outside that path should mark resolution whose direction relays for six hours.
mechanism.side: direction of the final close outside the first-six-hour close path
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCRR uses high implied-volatility levels, an eight-hour fixed block, first-six-hour path efficiency, and a last-two-hour range escape. It does not use CVVIB's joint volatility expansion/late ignition, any within-hour absorption, funding direction, or stablecoin flow.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour high-volatility chop-resolution geometry is absent from Gross9 and decisions occur only three times daily

clock.decision: exact UTC 00:00/08:00/16:00 boundary D after eight consecutive completed source-valid hours [D-8h,D)
clock.volatile_regime: BVOL close and DVOL close at D are each >= own strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.chop_path: first six hours use the initial open plus six hourly closes; normalized range is nonzero; efficiency=absolute initial-to-sixth-close return divided by normalized range <= strict-prior 270-block q40 with 252 observations
clock.resolution: absolute return over the final two hours >= strict-prior 270-block q60 with 252 observations and final close is strictly above the first-six-hour maximum or below its minimum
clock.reservation: blocks are nonoverlapping; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.volatility: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C BVOL/DVOL snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.completed_price_path: reuse hash-bound OLIAH completed-hour intrahour snapshot through 2026-08-01
